summary: Frontend-only validation on deployed preview URL of the 5 requested features: city landing pages (/city/London|Birmingham|Manchester|Leeds|Sheffield), Home 'Browse by city' tiles, Save & Compare (/saved compare table with async /api/quote insurance), listings inventory/photos/gallery, and operator dashboard tracking badge. All 5 features work as specified. No critical or blocking issues found; only 3 cosmetic/consistency nits.

minor.issue: Frontend issues a request to /api/ on every page load which returns 404 (console error noise). /api/auth/me 401 for anon users is expected.

issues: City tiles render '0 cars' for a moment before GET /api/listings resolves (observed 'London | 0 cars' on first paint); consider a skeleton or hiding the count until loaded

ve-001 detail page shows £169/£169.20 weekly (12-week term discount applied by weeklyForWeeks) while search card and compare table show the base £180 — same car appears at two prices across screens; consider labelling the discounted figure explicitly in compare/search
'Back to grid' / 'Compare N cars' button sits very tight against the 'Saved cars' heading block on mobile; minor crowding

action_items: Optional: suppress the stray GET /api/ 404 request on page load
Optional: avoid '0 cars' flash on Home city tiles while listings load
Optional: reconcile weekly rent shown on vehicle detail (term-discounted) vs search/compare (base rate)
critical_code_review_comments: Saved.jsx quote effect depends on `items` (a new array each render) and `quotes`, so it re-runs on every render; the `quotes[v.id] !== undefined` guard prevents an infinite POST loop today, but it is fragile — prefer keying the effect on saved ids joined string.
Saved.jsx allIn() treats an unresolved/failed insurance quote as £0, so the 'Best all-in price' highlight can be momentarily wrong before quotes resolve (verified it settles correctly after load).
CityPage.jsx falls back to the raw :name param for unknown cities and would render an undefined hero image (CITY_IMAGES[city] undefined) — add a 404/redirect for non-LIVE_CITIES.

success_rate.backend: n/a (frontend-only scope; spot-checked /api/listings & /api/quote — all 200 with correct counts)

seed_data_creation: None. Used existing seeded listings ve-001..ve-180 and localStorage key caro_saved for save/compare.
test_credentials: /app/memory/test_credentials.md present; not needed — city pages, saved and operator dashboard are public.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified via Playwright on https://minicab-marketplace.preview.emergentagent.com : (1) All 5 city pages render hero h1 with city name, 4 city-stat cards (London: 100 cars/14 operators/30 areas/£130 from; other cities 20/3/8/£170), 9 vehicle cards, 4 'city-link-<City>' chips (chip nav works), and city-see-all navigates to /search?city=<City>. (2) Home tiles home-city-<City> show correct counts after load and navigate to /city/<City>. (3) Save & Compare: hearts (save-btn-ve-001..003) persist to localStorage caro_saved, /saved shows '3 vehicles saved', compare-toggle renders compare-table with 3 columns and all 10 rows; insurance resolved to £44.00 via POST /api/quote (no lingering '…'), all-in maths correct (232/234/219), single 'Best all-in price' badge on cheapest, compare-apply-<id> navigates to /apply/<id>, compare-remove-<id> removes and updates count/localStorage. (4) GET /api/listings returns 180 (London 100, others 20 each), 3 photos each on static.prod-images.emergentagent.com, colours include Red (10) and Green (4); /vehicle/ve-001 gallery shows 1/3 with working gallery-prev/gallery-next. (5) /operator-dashboard fleet-map shows tracking-launch-badge 'Preview · live GPS tracking goes live at launch'. Mobile 390px: no horizontal page overflow, compare table scrolls internally (358 vs 763px).
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defects reproduced. The earlier-observed 'London | 0 cars' tile was a pre-fetch render state (all=[] initially in Home.jsx), and a stale-looking screenshot of Sheffield cards was a screenshot timing artefact — API-verified Sheffield boroughs (City Centre/Burngreave/Attercliffe/...) render correctly.
